issues.legal_issue: Stamp duty on a conveyance is determined by the property's market value on the date the conveyance is executed, unless the stated consideration is higher.

The market value of property occupied by tenants may be determined using comparable sales of tenanted property or, if none are available, by deducting an appropriate amount from the value of comparable unencumbered property.
The market value of property occupied by tenants must account for the effect of the tenancy, with the appropriate deduction determined from the tenancy's nature and the relevant evidence.
Interest on deficit stamp duty is mandatory under the applicable provision, while the penalty determination remains undisturbed where it was not challenged.
